browse_api.description:
The Motown Sound – Volume 7: A Collection of 16 Original Big Hits

Label: Motown
Catalog Number: MT 661
Format: Vinyl LP

Classic Motown compilation featuring some of the label's biggest stars, including:

  • The Temptations – Ain't Too Proud to Beg
  • Diana Ross & The Supremes – Back in My Arms Again
  • Marvin Gaye – I'll Be Doggone
  • Marvin Gaye & Kim Weston – It Takes Two
  • Stevie Wonder – A Place in the Sun
  • Smokey Robinson & The Miracles – My Girl Has Gone
  • Martha & The Vandellas – I'm Ready for Love
  • Four Tops – Shake Me, Wake Me (When It's Over)
  • Tammi Terrell
  • The Marvelettes
  • Jr. Walker & The All-Stars
  • Jimmy Ruffin
  • Shorty Long
  • The Elgins

A great sampler of classic Motown hits and an excellent addition to any soul or R&B collection.

Condition
